title.en: This and that: this, these, that, those
title.sl: This and that (kazalni zaimki): this, these, that, those
title.de: This and that (Demonstrativpronomen): this, these, that, those
title.it: This and that (i dimostrativi): this, these, that, those

rule.en:
**this** is for one thing near you, **these** for more than one: **this cup**, **these cups**. **that** is for one thing further away, **those** for more: **that fell**, **those boats**. They change only for how many, never for a man or a woman: **this man**, **this woman**.

They go before a noun (**this scone**) or stand alone: **What's this?** **This is Jack.** To leave out a noun said already, say **this one** or **that one**: **Which cup? — This one.**

**This is …** says who someone is (**This is Mrs Birkett.**) and who you are on the phone (**Hello, this is Sam.**). **That's** is short for **that is** (**That's lovely!**); **this is** has no short form.

In the answer, **it** and **they** take over: **What's this? — It's a pen.** **What are those? — They're bees.**

For time, **this** is now or today's: **this morning**, **this week**; **that** is another time: **that day**.
rule.sl:
**this** je za eno stvar blizu tebe, **these** za več: **this cup** (ta skodelica), **these cups** (te skodelice). **that** je za eno stvar dlje stran, **those** za več: **that fell** (tisti hrib), **those boats** (tisti čolni). Spreminjajo se samo po številu, nikoli po spolu: **this man** (ta moški), **this woman** (ta ženska).

Stojijo pred samostalnikom (**this scone**) ali same: **What's this?** (Kaj je to?) **This is Jack.** (To je Jack.) Da ne ponoviš samostalnika, reci **this one** ali **that one**: **Which cup? — This one.** (Katera skodelica? — Ta.)

**This is …** pove, kdo je kdo (**This is Mrs Birkett.** To je gospa Birkett.), po telefonu pa, kdo si (**Hello, this is Sam.** Halo, Sam tukaj.). **That's** je kratko za **that is** (**That's lovely!** Lepo!); **this is** kratke oblike nima.

V odgovoru prevzameta **it** in **they**: **What's this? — It's a pen.** (Kaj je to? — Pisalo.) **What are those? — They're bees.** (Kaj je tisto? — Čebele.)

Pri času je **this** zdaj ali današnji: **this morning** (danes zjutraj), **this week** (ta teden); **that** je drugič: **that day** (tisti dan).
rule.de:
**this** steht für ein Ding in deiner Nähe, **these** für mehrere: **this cup** (diese Tasse), **these cups** (diese Tassen). **that** steht für ein Ding weiter weg, **those** für mehrere: **that fell** (der Berg dort), **those boats** (die Boote dort). Sie ändern sich nur nach der Zahl, nie nach dem Geschlecht: **this man** (dieser Mann), **this woman** (diese Frau).

Sie stehen vor einem Nomen (**this scone**) oder allein: **What's this?** (Was ist das?) **This is Jack.** (Das ist Jack.) Damit du ein Nomen nicht wiederholst, sag **this one** oder **that one**: **Which cup? — This one.** (Welche Tasse? — Diese.)

**This is …** sagt, wer jemand ist (**This is Mrs Birkett.**), und am Telefon, wer du bist (**Hello, this is Sam.** Hallo, hier ist Sam.). **That's** ist kurz für **that is** (**That's lovely!** Wie schön!); **this is** hat keine Kurzform.

In der Antwort übernehmen **it** und **they**: **What's this? — It's a pen.** (Was ist das? — Ein Stift.) **What are those? — They're bees.** (Was ist das dort? — Bienen.)

Bei der Zeit ist **this** jetzt oder heute: **this morning** (heute Morgen), **this week** (diese Woche); **that** ist ein anderes Mal: **that day** (an dem Tag).
rule.it:
**this** è per una cosa vicina a te, **these** per più cose: **this cup** (questa tazza), **these cups** (queste tazze). **that** è per una cosa più lontana, **those** per più cose: **that fell** (quel monte), **those boats** (quelle barche). Cambiano solo per il numero, mai per maschile o femminile: **this man** (quest'uomo), **this woman** (questa donna).

Stanno davanti a un nome (**this scone**) o da soli: **What's this?** (Che cos'è questo?) **This is Jack.** (Questo è Jack.) Per non ripetere un nome già detto, di' **this one** o **that one**: **Which cup? — This one.** (Quale tazza? — Questa.)

**This is …** dice chi è qualcuno (**This is Mrs Birkett.**) e al telefono chi sei tu (**Hello, this is Sam.** Pronto, sono Sam.). **That's** è breve per **that is** (**That's lovely!** Che bello!); **this is** non ha la forma breve.

Nella risposta subentrano **it** e **they**: **What's this? — It's a pen.** (Che cos'è? — È una penna.) **What are those? — They're bees.** (Che cosa sono quelle? — Sono api.)

Per il tempo **this** è adesso o di oggi: **this morning** (stamattina), **this week** (questa settimana); **that** è un'altra volta: **that day** (quel giorno).

examples.sl: To je Jack, to pa je Meg, ovčarski pes.
examples.de: Das ist Jack, und das ist Meg, der Hütehund.
examples.it: Questo è Jack, e questa è Meg, la cagna pastore.

note.sl: This is … pove, kdo je kdo.

note.it: This is … dice chi è qualcuno.

examples.en: These scones are lovely, Granny Maggie!
examples.sl: Ti sconi so odlični, babica Maggie!
examples.de: Diese Scones sind köstlich, Oma Maggie!
examples.it: Questi scones sono buonissimi, nonna Maggie!

examples.en: Those boats on the lake are from Keswick.
examples.sl: Tisti čolni na jezeru so iz Keswicka.
examples.de: Die Boote dort auf dem See sind aus Keswick.
examples.it: Quelle barche sul lago sono di Keswick.

note.en: those: more than one, over there.

examples.en: What's that? — It's the old mill.
examples.de: Was ist das dort? — Die alte Mühle.
examples.it: Che cos'è quello? — È il vecchio mulino.

note.en: In the answer: it, not that.
note.de: In der Antwort it, nicht that.

examples.en: Hello, Mrs Birkett, this is Sam.
examples.de: Hallo, Mrs Birkett, hier ist Sam.

note.en: On the phone: this is, never here is.
note.sl: Po telefonu this is, nikoli here is.
note.de: Am Telefon this is, nie here is.
note.it: Al telefono this is, mai here is.

examples.en: Which cup is hot? — This one.
